title: Jingfang granules alleviate atopic dermatitis by restoring skin barrier function and inhibiting NF-kappaB/NLRP3 axis and JAK/STAT3 axis.
authors: Tai, Yi; Cao, Shen; Zhong, Weiwei; Li, Shirong; Han, Jing; Liu, Xinzhe; Cao, Sheng; Wang, Xinyu; Jin, Shufeng; Liu, Caiqin; Shen, Yiqian; Xing, Yue; Li, Ming Yue; Zuo, Hong Xiang; Zhang, Guimin; Ma, Juan; Jin, Xuejun
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究荆防颗粒通过NF-κB/NLRP3和JAK/STAT3通路缓解特应性皮炎，仅涉及信号通路蛋白，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Atopic dermatitis (AD) is a recurrent inflammatory disease that significantly impacts patients' quality of life. Jingfang Granules (JFG) have been employed in the therapeutic management of AD and psoriasis (PSO), in contemporary clinical practice. However, further research is required to elucidate the molecular mechanisms of JFG in AD therapy. PURPOSE: The present study aims to explore the potential mechanisms by which JFG alleviate AD. METHODS: Ultra Performance Liquid Chromatography-Tandem Mass Spectrometry (UPLC-MS/MS) and metabolomics were used to identify the absorbed components in the blood of JFG. BALB/c mice were continuously topically treated with 1-Chloro-2,4-dinitrobenzene (DNCB) on the dorsal skin to establish AD-mice model. The skin lesions, trans epidermal water loss (TEWL), scoring of atopic dermatitis (SCORAD), hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining, and inflammatory cytokines in serum were analyzed to elucidate the effects of JFG on AD. Furthermore, network pharmacology was employed to predict the potential active components and JFG targets of AD therapy. In vitro, the potential pharmacological effects of JFG toward AD were further elucidated using flow cytometry, western blot, reverse transcription-PCR (RT-PCR), immunofluorescence and enzyme linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). RESULTS: Based on UPLC-MC/MS and metabolomics, a total of 901 components were identified in serum, with 365 confirmed as JFG-derived absorbed components. These components were predominantly enriched in amino acid metabolic pathways. In vivo, JFG significantly alleviated the pathological changes, including pruritus and impairment of skin barrier function damage in AD mice, while significantly reducing TEWL, SCORAD, inflammatory cytokines release and splenic index. Network pharmacology and molecular docking analyses indicated that these potential therapeutic targets were predominantly enriched in the inflammatory response and the tumor necrosis factor (TNF) signaling pathway, which primarily involved ALB, BCL2, EGFR, GAPDH, IL6, NFKB1, STAT3 and TNF targets. Mechanistically, JFG reduced inflammatory response through NF-kappaB/NLRP3 axis and JAK/STAT3 axis, and restored the expression of tight junction proteins (TJPs) Occludin, Zonula occludens-1 (ZO-1) and Claudin-1, thus restoring skin barrier function and improving AD. CONCLUSION: The present study confirmed that JFG alleviate atopic dermatitis by restoring skin barrier function and inhibiting NF-kappaB/NLRP3 axis and JAK/STAT3 axis. JFGs demonstrate potential therapeutic efficacy for treating AD.
abstract_zh: 背景：特应性皮炎（AD）是一种复发性炎症性疾病，显著影响患者的生活质量。荆防颗粒（JFG）已在当代临床实践中用于AD和银屑病（PSO）的治疗管理。然而，仍需进一步研究以阐明JFG在AD治疗中的分子机制。目的：本研究旨在探讨JFG缓解AD的潜在机制。方法：采用超高效液相色谱-串联质谱（UPLC-MS/MS）和代谢组学方法鉴定JFG血液中的吸收成分。通过连续在BALB/c小鼠背部皮肤局部涂抹1-氯-2,4-二硝基苯（DNCB）建立AD小鼠模型。分析皮肤病变、经表皮水分丢失（TEWL）、特应性皮炎评分（SCORAD）、苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色及血清中炎症细胞因子，以阐明JFG对AD的作用。此外，采用网络药理学预测JFG治疗AD的潜在活性成分和靶点。在体外，通过流式细胞术、蛋白质印迹、逆转录-聚合酶链反应（RT-PCR）、免疫荧光和酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）进一步阐明JFG对AD的潜在药理作用。结果：基于UPLC-MS/MS和代谢组学，在血清中共鉴定出901种成分，其中365种被确认为JFG来源的吸收成分。这些成分主要富集于氨基酸代谢通路。在体内，JFG显著缓解了AD小鼠的病理变化，包括瘙痒和皮肤屏障功能损伤，同时显著降低TEWL、SCORAD、炎症细胞因子释放和脾指数。网络药理学和分子对接分析表明，这些潜在治疗靶点主要富集于炎症反应和肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）信号通路，主要涉及ALB、BCL2、EGFR、GAPDH、IL6、NFKB1、STAT3和TNF靶点。机制上，JFG通过NF-kappaB/NLRP3轴和JAK/STAT3轴减少炎症反应，并恢复紧密连接蛋白（TJPs）Occludin、Zonula occludens-1（ZO-1）和Claudin-1的表达，从而恢复皮肤屏障功能并改善AD。结论：本研究证实JFG通过恢复皮肤屏障功能及抑制NF-kappaB/NLRP3轴和JAK/STAT3轴来缓解特应性皮炎。JFG显示出治疗AD的潜在疗效。
